[Burst] Add this card to your hand.
[When Paired] If this is a (Mafty) Unit, choose 1 of your (Mafty) Units. During this turn, it may choose a damaged active enemy Unit as its attack target.

[Burst] Activate this card's [Main].

671951.Description: [During Pair] [Attack] [Once per Turn] If this Unit is attacking the enemy player, reveal 1 (Earth Federation) Unit card from your hand. Return to the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw 2.
